title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Vorhees traded to Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons acquired offensive guard Andrew Vorhees and undisclosed draft compensation in exchange for offensive lineman Ryan Neuzil.
items.impact: Baltimore and Atlanta swap offensive lineman. Vorhees will add depth at the guard position for the Falcons.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ryan Neuzil traded to Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens acquired offensive lineman Ryan Neuzil from the Atlanta Falcons in exchange for offensive guard Andrew Vorhees and undisclosed draft compensation.
items.impact: It is a swap of offensive lineman between Baltimore and Atlanta. Neuzil will add depth for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle McCord to start at QB for Dolphins
items.desc: Kyle McCord will start for the Dolphins in Week 10 against the Colts.
items.impact: Malik Willis was placed on injured reserve on Tuesday. McCord will take over for him behind center.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Pollard will not be traded
items.desc: The Titans are not trading RB Tony Pollard.
items.impact: Pollard will remain in Tennessee the rest of the season. He should remain a steady RB2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Willis (groin) placed on IR
items.desc: The Dolphins are placing QB Malik Willis on injured reserve.
items.impact: Willis has been battling a groin injury that impacted his mobility. He underwent an MRI that showed it has now developed into a core muscle injury. He will miss at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Downs traded to Chiefs
items.desc: The Colts are trading wide receiver Josh Downs to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Downs had requested a trade and now officially gets his request as he joins Patrick Mahomes and Kansas City. The Chiefs were looking to address their wide receiver room and they do so here bringing in Downs. He should be the No. 2 target for Mahomes behind Rashee Rice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Westbrook-Ikhine signs with Colts active roster
items.desc: The Colts signed WR Nick Westbrook-Ikhine to their active roster.
items.impact: Westbrook-Ikhine will add depth in the wide receiver room for Indianapolis after trading Keenan Allen.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) to return to practice this week
items.desc: The Panthers are opening up the practice window for WR Xavier Legette this week.
items.impact: Legette will have 21 days to officially be activated by Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Moore released by Panthers
items.desc: The Panthers released WR David Moore.
items.impact: Moore will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daiyan Henley traded to Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos are trading for LB Daiyan Henley.
items.impact: Henley has recorded one interception and one forced fumble this season for the Chargers. He will add depth in the Broncos linebacker room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathan Taylor will not be traded by Colts
items.desc: The Colts won't trade RB Jonathan Taylor by Tuesday's deadline.
items.impact: Pelissero notes that multiple teams offered a second-round pick and more for Taylor, but the Colts wanted more in a deal for him. He'll remain in Indianapolis.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Fernando Mendoza to start in Week 10 against Seattle
items.desc: Raiders QB Fernando Mendoza will make his first career start in Week 10 against the Seahawks.
items.impact: With Kirk Cousins traded to the Vikings, Mendoza is set to take over the rest of the season for the Raiders. The rookie will face a pair of tough tests in his first two starts against the Seahawks and Broncos.

items.author: Kelly Kirby
items.title: Kirk Cousins traded to Vikings
items.desc: Kirk Cousins and the Raiders are finalizing a deal to trade the QB to the Vikings. Reports say Minnesota is sending Las Vegas a third-round pick in the deal.
items.impact: Cousins spent six years in Minnesota, where he threw for 23,265 yards and 171 touchdowns in 88 games with a passer rating of 101.2. He will reunite with an offense he knows, which increases the fantasy value for Minnesota pass catchers, particularly Justin Jefferson. Cousins remains fantasy relevant as a high-end QB2 with some low-end QB1 potential.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Amani Hooker traded to Bills
items.desc: The Titans are trading safety Amani Hooker to the Bills.
items.impact: Hooker will add experience and depth in the secondary for Buffalo. He has logged five interceptions on the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keenan Allen traded to 49ers
items.desc: The Colts are trading WR Keenan Allen to the 49ers for a 2027 sixth-round pick
items.impact: With Mike Evans still sidelined and Deebo Samuel working his way back to practice this week, San Francisco adds depth to its wide receiver room with a veteran in Allen. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar unless both Evans and Samuel continue to miss time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practices Tuesday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo was practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Skattebo remains on track to return for Thursday's game against the Commanders. He is expected to be a full-go.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: J.J. McCarthy (hip) practices Tuesday
items.desc: J.J. McCarthy was practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: McCarthy remains on track to be good to go for Thursday's game against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyreek Hill (knee) expected to be medically cleared in a few weeks
items.desc: Tyreek Hill's agent Drew Rosenhaus said Hill is expected to be medically cleared in a few weeks.
items.impact: Hill will be an option for a team that doesn't land a wide receiver ahead of Tuesday's trade deadline.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kendre Miller visiting Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys are hosting RB Kendre Miller for a visit.
items.impact: Miller was recently released by the Saints. The Cowboys backfield is banged up behind Javonte Williams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Aguilar signs with Cardinals' active roster
items.desc: The Cardinals signed QB Joey Aguilar to their active roster.
items.impact: Aguilar will add depth in the quarterback room for Arizona behind Carson Beck.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zaire Mitchell-Paden signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed TE Zaire Mitchell-Paden to their practice squad.
items.impact: Mitchell-Paden began his career with the Browns as an undrafted free agent. He returns to Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Aiyuk officially reinstated
items.desc: Brandon Aiyuk passed his physical Monday and was officially reinstated.
items.impact: The next step for Aiyuk is hoping for a release from San Francisco. Schultz notes that at least one NFC team has internally discussed the possibility of adding Aiyuk to its practice squad when he is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Evan Engram draws trade interest, not expected to be moved
items.desc: Broncos TE Evan Engram has garnered trade interest, but he's considered unlikely to be moved.
items.impact: Engram has caught 17 passes for 169 yards and a touchdown so far this season in Denver.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Sieler out for season with ruptured biceps
items.desc: Dolphins DT Zach Sieler ruptured his biceps and will undergo season-ending surgery.
items.impact: Sieler suffered the injury on the first play of the game on Sunday. His expected recovery timeline is 5-to-6 months.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lucas Patrick placed in concussion protocol
items.desc: The Commanders placed Lucas Patrick in concussion protocol.
items.impact: Patrick will likely sit Thursday's game against the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Arnold Ebiketie trade falls through
items.desc: The Bengals and Eagles deal for DE Arnold Ebiketie has fallen through and will not happen.
items.impact: The Bengals had moved a 6th-round pick for Ebiketie. The trade falling through is not physical or performance related.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jake Moody signs with Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons signed kicker Jake Moody.
items.impact: Moody will kick for Atlanta with Nick Folk released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Folk released by Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons released kicker Nick Folk.
items.impact: Folk went 13-for-18 on field goal attempts. Atlanta signed Jake Moody as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Darnell Savage Jr. is healthy
items.desc: Former Packers first-round draft pick and starting safety Darnell Savage is healthy again.
items.impact: Savage has 371 career tackles and 10 interceptions in the NFL. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brian Thomas Jr. not expected to be traded
items.desc: The Jaguars are not expected to trade WR Brian Thomas Jr.
items.impact: Jacksonville plans to keep its roster intact after making some big trades on Monday. Fowler notes the Jaguars have told teams they plan to keep Thomas.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Max Brosmer decent in mop-up duty Monday night
items.desc: Max Brosmer completed 6-of-7 passes for 58 yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the BIlls.
items.impact: After Carson Wentz struggled terribly in this game, Brosmer came on in relief to lead the Vikings' final drive. The second-year QB actually did okay, but he's most likely to remain in a backup role for the Vikings moving forward.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Carson Wentz absolutely awful in Monday night loss
items.desc: Carson Wentz completed only 8-of-25 passes for 81 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
items.impact: Earlier this season, Wentz had some bright moments at the helm of the Vikings' offense. That's a distant memory now, as the veteran QB couldn't even finish Monday's contest without being benched in favor of third-stringer Max Brosmer. Wentz may have very well played his final snaps for the Vikings.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. gets just six touches on Monday night
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. gained 16 yards on five carries and caught his only target for five yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
items.impact: Jones' paltry production in this one wasn't the result of backfield mate Jordan Mason seeing a surge in touches, as the latter finished with just seven of his own. The Vikings' offense is all out of sorts at the moment, and their RB tandem is suffering as a result. Jones looked like he might have found the Fountain of Youth earlier this season, but over the last three weeks, the veteran has given fantasy managers next to nothing.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jordan Mason totals 42 yards on Monday night
items.desc: Jordan Mason rushed for 35 yards on six carries and added just seven yards on two receptions in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
items.impact: Mason missed a large chunk of the season early on. Then, he returned to gain 68 yards on 15 carries in a win over the Colts in Week 7. Any encouragement that resulted from that performance is gone now, as the Vikings just cannot get things together on offense. Mason has gained 55 yards on just 14 carries combined over the last two games. He's a bench stash for fantasy purposes right now.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Justin Jefferson catches three passes in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Justin Jefferson hauled in only 3-of-11 targets for 58 yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
items.impact: Jefferson is one of the league's top talents at wide receiver. Still, the Vikings' inept quarterback play so far this season has turned the All-Pro into an inconsistent, boom-or-bust asset for fantasy managers. Jefferson is in the low-end WR2 discussion at present, but if the Vikings can figure things out at QB, he would fly back up the rankings.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jordan Addison finishes with 28 yards Monday night
items.desc: Jordan Addison caught 2-of-3 targets for 28 yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
items.impact: Addison has now finished with two or fewer receptions four times in seven games this season, as the inconsistent quarterback play in Minnesota this season has really limited his production. The speedy receiver possesses big-play ability, but if the Vikings don't figure things out at QB, Addison will remain a highly volatile fantasy option.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: T.J. Hockenson hauls in four passes Monday night
items.desc: T.J. Hockenson caught 4-of-7 targets for 33 yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
items.impact: Hockenson actually led the Vikings in receptions Monday night, but the offense was pretty much shut down on the whole. The veteran TE has had a decent season to this point despite lacking QB play for the Vikings. Hockenson had scored in two straight games going into Monday night, and he's now caught four passes in three consecutive weeks.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Carson Beck set to start Week 10
items.desc: Carson Beck is in line to start at quarterback against the Rams on Sunday.
items.impact: With Jacoby Brissett now in Baltimore and Gardner Minshew (elbow) out of action, Beck will get his opportunity to lead the Arizona offense beginning in Week 10. The Cardinals are also beaten up at wide receiver, and the Rams present one of the more difficult matchups in the league for any quarterback. Beck will indeed have his work cut out for him in order to make a positive impression. The third-round rookie has yet to take a snap in a regular-season game.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Josh Allen turns in decent performance Monday night
items.desc: Josh Allen completed 21 of 31 passes for 234 yards with one touchdown and one interception, adding 15 yards on six carries in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: This performance was certainly below the norm for Allen, but considering it came against arguably the league's top defense, it was serviceable. Allen eclipsed 2,000 yards passing for the season in this one, and he's now up to a dozen touchdown passes along with a whopping nine rushing scores. Allen remains one of the top fantasy assets in the league regardless of position. He should be set for a larger output against the Jets in Week 10.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Ty Johnson goes for 37 yards on three touches in Week 9
items.desc: Ty Johnson rushed one time for just one yard but gained 36 yards on two receptions in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: It's well known that Johnson makes the vast majority of his contributions to the Bills as a receiver out of the backfield. That was the case again Monday night. He didn't do much on two of his touches, but he took one of his receptions 36 yards top give him the game's longest gain. Johnson doesn't carry much fantasy appeal outside the deepest of PPR leagues.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: James Cook II goes over 100 yards, finds end zone in Week 9
items.desc: James Cook II rushed for 107 yards and a touchdown on 31 carries in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: This was a true workhorse effort from Cook. The last time he got 30-plus carries was Week 13 of last season. Cook is one of only three backs in the league currently averaging over 100 rushing yards per game, and Jahmyr Gibbs is the only player carrying the ball more times per game than Cook.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: DJ Moore totals 36 yards in Monday's win
items.desc: DJ Moore caught 3-of-5 targets for 25 yards, adding 11 yards on one carry in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: Moore had a big game in his return to action against the Ravens in Week 8. He couldn't replicate the effort in Week 9, but he is healthy and stronger fantasy performances should be on the way. Moore is best viewed as a low-end WR2 or high-end WR3.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Khalil Shakir leads Bills in receiving Monday night
items.desc: Khalil Shakir brought down all four of his targets for 58 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: Shakir tied for the team lead in catches and topped the Bills in receiving yards Monday night. Shakir has now caught four or more passes in four of the last five games, averaging 4.6 receptions and 63.6 yards per game in that span.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Keon Coleman finishes with three receptions Monday night
items.desc: Keon Coleman caught 3-of-6 targets for 17 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: Coleman has had a few strong games this season. He even had a stretch of three straight weeks with a touchdown. Since then, Coleman has managed only four receptions for 21 yards over the last two games. The third-year receiver is just unreliable from a fantasy standpoint.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Keleki Latu hits paydirt in Week 9
items.desc: Keleki Latu caught his only target for a 25-yard touchdown in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: Latu has seen very limited snaps on offense this season, as he's largely a contributor on special teams for the Bills. Latu got his first target of the season Monday night and made it count, scoring his first career touchdown.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Dalton Kincaid catches three passes in Week 9 win
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid hauled in all three of his targets for 28 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: Kincaid's up-and-down campaign continued Monday night. The fourth-year TE has pretty much become a feast-or-famine fantasy option at this point. Proceed accordingly.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Dawson Knox hauls in four passes Monday night
items.desc: Dawson Knox secured 4-of-5 targets for 37 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: Knox put up season highs in receptions and yards in Week 9. This has not been a very productive season for the veteran tight end, at least from a fantasy perspective. Knox is still a mainstay on the field for the Bills, but his value to the team is much higher than his fantasy upside.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Vikings D/ST picks up four sacks in Week 9 loss
items.desc: The Vikings' defense gave up 23 points on 339 yards of total offense, registering four sacks and forcing one turnover in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
items.impact: The Vikings' defense got pretty much no help from the offense in this one, but the unit hung tough regardless. The Vikings head into Week 10 tied for the league lead in sacks (29) and ranked second in yards allowed per game (280.0). Minnesota also ranks first in points allowed per game at 14.5.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Will Reichard makes a pair of field goals in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Will Reichard made both of his field-goal attempts in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
items.impact: The Vikings' offense was almost completely stifled Monday night, leaving Reichard as the only Minnesota player to put up any points. The third-year kicker is 1-of-5 in the NFL with as many as 20 field goals made so far this season, and he's missed just two in the process.
